facts.fact: Replit states that the Free Mode allowances for the Core and Pro plans reset every five hours.
facts.quote: The Core and Pro allowances reset every five hours and have weekly limits.

facts.fact: Replit states that the Core and Pro Free Mode allowances also have weekly limits, in addition to the five-hour reset.
facts.quote: The Core and Pro allowances reset every five hours and have weekly limits.

facts.fact: Replit states that Auto mode selects models automatically for paid work in Power or Max on the Core and Pro plans.
facts.quote: Automatic model selection for paid work in Power or Max on Core and Pro.

facts.fact: Replit describes Power mode as a paid, mid-tier Agent mode.
facts.quote: A paid, mid-tier mode with powerful models at an affordable price.

facts.fact: Replit describes Max mode as a paid, top-tier Agent mode that uses the best frontier models.
facts.quote: A paid, top-tier mode with the best frontier models for the most demanding work.

facts.fact: Replit states that for requests needing more capability than Free Mode, Agent may offer a paid 'Allow once' option, and Replit asks for confirmation before any paid action starts.
facts.quote: Replit asks for confirmation before a paid action starts, and Agent returns to Free Mode afterward.
